description: All corpus ingest sources. ownership: owned=c3po creates+maintains, subscribed=another PI project owns (read-only sync), aware=external/federated (no ingest pipeline).

substack.notes: Protocolized Substack newsletter. Incremental sync via API (updated_at comparison). 4 vector types: body, post_summary, collection_card, author_profile.

pdfs.notes: PDFs from data/pdfs/ — Summer of Protocols research archive + Protocolized resources. Run enrich_pdfs.py before ingest. 2 vector types: body, doc_summary.

youtube.notes: PI YouTube channel transcripts + summaries. Pipeline: fetch_youtube_meta.py → enrich_youtube.py → ingest_youtube.py. Namespace is 'videos' (not 'youtube') for historical reasons. 2 vector types: body, video_summary. 161 URLs pending transcript fetch.

discord.notes: 4 active channels (2 general, 2 forum) + 11 archived. REST API only, no gateway. Starred messages get 1.0x weight, unstarred 0.7x.

sig.notes: 4 active SIG channels: SIGFPT, MRG, SIGPfB, ProtFiSIG. Includes meeting summaries (Claude-enriched), discussion threads, and main messages. 5 chunk types: sig_message, sig_reply, sig_discussion, sig_meeting_body, sig_meeting_summary.

bibliography.notes: Curated reference list from Protocolized content. Enriched via Semantic Scholar API. Relevance scores 0-3 stored as metadata. 2 vector types: ref_summary, body (for downloaded PDFs).

definitions.notes: PI-coined and PI-specific terminology. Source: sources/lexicon_draft.json. Only triage a+b entries (~560 vectors). Injected into system prompt as authoritative PI vocabulary. Weight: 1.0x.

discord_links.notes: URLs shared in Discord channels, fetched and embedded as link summaries. 3-step pipeline: extract from discord → fetch_discord_links.py → enrich_discord_links.py (score/prune). 3,824 URLs in registry.

transcripts.notes: Real-time transcripts from voice channels, produced by listener bot. Grows with usage. Currently 4 vectors. Ingest pipeline TBD — will be a sink output that feeds back as a source.

inbox.notes: One-off submitted content (PDFs, URLs, text files) dropped into data/inbox/. Processed on file creation event by orchestrator watcher. data/inbox/ is gitignored.

humboldt.notes: Humboldt's private research embeddings in the shared Pinecone index. C3PO does not create, maintain, or query this namespace by default. Candidate for reclassification to 'subscribed' when the humboldt-c3po interface is formalized. Never include in default query routing.
